protocol.families: held-out rigid, affine, discontinuous, and analytic shear-band fields
protocol.baseline: no NDF field residual; local normalized cross-correlation and image-derived affine prefit
protocol.propagation_seed_rule: IC-GN status only; oracle and visibility are used only for scoring
protocol.region_definition: 8-connected components of oracle-correct windows, retaining components of at least 16 windows
protocol.pass_rule: each retained oracle region contains at least one first-pass accepted seed
protocol.solver: WebGPU inverse-compositional Gauss-Newton, unchanged 64 px subset, stride 64, 30 iterations, 1e-3 tolerance, ZNCC minimum 0.65
